Smart Campus Food Services

Better Meals.

MealCare brings campus food support into one simple place. Report a food concern, request meal support, and stay connected with the team taking care of your dining experience.

Get Started →
✓ Simple support  •  Faster response  •  Better food experiences
WHY MEALCARE

Good food should come with good care.

Whether it's a food quality concern, a dietary need, or feedback about today's meal, MealCare gives students one clear place to ask for support, follow their requests, and share their experience.

01
Quick Support Your request reaches the right team automatically.
02
Clear Progress Follow your request from submission to resolution.
03
Your Voice Matters Share feedback and help make campus dining better.
FOOD SUPPORT

How can we help with your meal?

From everyday meal requests to food safety concerns, choose the support you need.

01

Food Quality Concern

Report undercooked, stale, spoiled, or poor-quality food.

02

Meal Not Available

Let the food team know when a listed meal is unavailable.

03

Food Hygiene

Report cleanliness or hygiene concerns around food service.

04

Special Diet Support

Request support for vegetarian, vegan, halal, or other dietary needs.

05

Allergy Management

Request allergen-aware meal handling and support.

06

Menu Feedback

Share your thoughts about taste, variety, and menu options.

07

Reserve a Meal

Request a meal reservation or pre-book your meal in advance.

08

Missed Meal Support

Request assistance when classes or exams cause you to miss a meal.

09

Food Waste Reporting

Help identify unnecessary food waste and support better planning.

10

Emergency Food Support

Request food assistance during emergencies or unexpected late arrivals.

11

Mess Billing Support

Raise concerns about meal charges or hostel mess fees.

12

Smart Menu Suggestions

Explore personalized meal suggestions based on your needs.

ABOUT MEALCARE

Built to make campus food support simpler.

Team Tech Titans built MealCare to give students one simple place to report food-related concerns and request support, while helping hostel staff use an AI-assisted system to classify, prioritize, and resolve requests more efficiently.
